affected.note: Sum of the category figures (no overall total stated): about 143,000 policyholders and insured, about 399,000 people who requested quotes or materials (revised on 2026-05-15 to about 335,000 plus about 64,000 auto insurance customers registered through pet insurance system operations, same total), about 1,000 liability insurance victims, about 10,000 veterinary clinics and partners, and 199 agencies. Bank account data is included for some. The intrusion window was 2025-03-19 to 2025-04-21.

summary.en: AXA General Insurance reported unauthorized access to part of its pet insurance system and found that an intruder may have tried to extract customer data between 2025-03-19 and 2025-04-21. About 553,000 records, including names, addresses, birthdates and some bank account details, may have leaked.
summary.ja: アクサ損害保険は、ペット保険のシステムの一部が不正アクセスを受け、2025年3月19日から4月21日にかけて第三者が情報を抜き取ろうとしていた可能性があると公表した。氏名、住所、生年月日や一部の金融機関口座情報などを含む約55万件の情報が漏えいした可能性がある。
